executiveSummary: Active OT intrusions: U.S. government warns Iranian‑affiliated actors are modifying PLC logic and HMI/SCADA displays across sectors; immediate removal of direct internet access to controllers and RUN‑mode locking is advised. Security Advisory Operational disruption: A coordinated cyberattack hit 30+ Minnesota water systems, forcing manual operations and at least one plant offline—validating current OT threat warnings on internet‑exposed PLC/HMI paths. View Article Perimeter/VPN risks: Critical, actively exploited flaws at major edge vendors elevate pivot risk into OT, including F5 BIG‑IP APM RCE, Ivanti EPMM unauthenticated RCE, and PAN‑OS GlobalProtect authentication bypass (CAS). CERT-FR Alert CERT-FR Alert JPCERT/CC Alert Internet‑scale exposure: 36,000+ IPMI interfaces (24,650 leaking RAKP hashes) remain exposed; BMC compromise has been abused for ransomware and enables deep lateral movement affecting OT-adjacent servers. View Article OT/ICS software and ecosystem risk: New critical issues include OpenWrt odhcpd pre‑auth overflow, Siemens Desigo CC OpenSSL chain, Microsoft/VMware mass patches, and multiple ICS‑adjacent CVEs (ibaPDA, PcVue, EV charging, BaSyx, Delta PLC). View Article CISA Advisory State/hacktivist activity: China‑nexus covert SOHO/IoT networks for CNI pre‑positioning and pro‑Russia groups brute‑forcing exposed VNC HMIs are ongoing priorities. Security Advisory Security Advisory
outlook72h: - Expect continued scanning and exploitation of exposed PLCs/HMIs and VNC; verify no Level‑0/1 devices are routable from the internet. - Prioritize emergency maintenance for F5 BIG‑IP APM, Ivanti EPMM, PAN‑OS, OpenWrt, VMware vCenter/ESXi, and Desigo CC; assess for pre‑patch compromise per BOD 26‑04 where applicable. - Increase monitoring for DNS/HTTPS exfiltration patterns tied to Zimbra/Exchange OWA campaigns and WSS tunnels from non‑browser processes in engineering zones. - Validate isolation runbooks enabling OT operations without enterprise connectivity; rehearse manual mode for critical processes.
